composition_label: Ticket triage & routing -> Document review -> Semantic search | Telecommunications

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory; no existing source or other builds read or copied.

shared_schema.transport: JSON contains schema_version, synthetic=true, policy, accounts, tickets (support chat transcripts), cdr_csv, documents, query, and optional config. Unknown fields are rejected.
shared_schema.canonical_envelope: All stages share schema_version, synthetic, status, stage, policy, rules, records, matches. Intake converts transport records into this envelope; canonical_validate validates each stage input and output.
shared_schema.canonical_record: ticket_id, account_id, subscriber_ref, residency, signals, urgent, usage (record_ids, call_seconds, data_mb), evidence (requirement -> provenance IDs), billing_adjustment (amount, reason_stated) with validated triage and review enrichments.
shared_schema.triage: category, priority (1 most urgent through 4), team, owner
shared_schema.review: checks (requirement, source_ids, satisfied), gaps (requirement, ticket_id, owner, reason), status (gaps_found or evidence_present), certification_claim=false
shared_schema.matches: ticket_id, residency, score, mode, review_status, gap_requirements
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error; CLI exit 2. Raw private input and exception details are never echoed.

cross_stage_handoffs: Intake validates subscriber accounts, per-record residency, consent, raw transcript shape, CDR CSV, proposed adjustment reason, document links, and query. It removes direct identifiers and source prose before constructing the canonical envelope.
Triage consumes validated intake signals, deterministically selects a configured category, urgency and accountable team/owner. Its output is revalidated.

Review consumes validated triage routing, uses that category's evidence requirements, and derives traceable gaps with the same accountable owner. An adjustment always adds a reason requirement. Its output is revalidated.

Semantic search consumes validated review output, builds a residency-partitioned local index from category, team, requirements and gaps, then emits ranked matches linked to review status and gap requirements. Its output is revalidated.

behavior.determinism: Whole-word keyword counts; configuration order breaks category ties; explicit fallback handles no matches; urgent keywords set priority 1; score descending then ticket_id ascending breaks search ties.
behavior.search: Default local cosine TF-IDF with a fixed telecom synonym map. Unknown query terms may return no matches. query.limit is 1..100. Indexing occurs only within the query residency; all records remain in the full pipeline result for the local caller.
behavior.optional_injection: run_pipeline(payload, embedder=callable) accepts an optional offline callable returning finite, bounded nonzero vectors. Dimensions must agree. Callback exceptions are sanitized. Test fixtures exercise valid vectors, invalid vectors, mismatched dimensions and failures; no provider is called.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented safeguards: explicit support_resolution purpose, subscriber consent, bounded declared retention (1..365 days), synthetic-only fixtures and data minimization. Raw phone, IMEI, transcript, evidence prose and billing reason text are absent from stage envelopes and stdout.
behavior.residency: Accounts, tickets, CDRs and documents each require an allowed residency tag; all linked records must match. Search rejects unallowed residency queries and never indexes another residency for that query.
behavior.billing: Every proposed adjustment, including a zero amount, requires a nonblank stated reason. No financial adjustment is executed.
behavior.evidence: Evidence presence means a nonblank supplied evidence value or validated linked CDR/reason, not truth verification or regulatory certification. Provenance IDs share an unambiguous namespace.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: Invented subscribers and support chats; explicitly fictitious +999 phone numbers and all-zero-prefix IMEIs. Example usage volumes are synthetic. Tests additionally generate randomized volumes with fixed seed 88.

included: Single integrated CLI and shared canonical schema/validation layer
Configurable category, priority, accountable routing and evidence requirements
Strict CDR CSV import and account-level usage aggregation
Traceable document evidence gaps without certification claims
Deterministic synthetic fixtures and unittest/CLI coverage
excluded: Production deployment, persistent storage and persistent search index
Live LLMs, live providers, external dependencies and network calls
Authentication, authorization, encryption and operational residency enforcement
Automated retention deletion, data-subject rights workflows and legal advice
Evidence authenticity verification, regulatory compliance and certification claims
Actual billing changes, telecom integration and full natural-language semantic models

test_outcomes.cli_error_contract: Verified missing arguments, extra arguments, missing file, invalid JSON, duplicate JSON keys and invalid payload: one JSON error object and exit 2.
test_outcomes.embedding_validation: Offline fixture callables passed; invalid, nonfinite, zero and mismatched vectors rejected; tiny finite vectors normalized safely.
